effects.text: Calm water to you. Mind the fold gate, neighbour. Something's counting our sheep before we do.
THE GREYTEETH FOLD: shepherds want sitters for the night. Rustlers about. Bring teeth and a friend.

quests.title: Wool on the Rocks
quests.summary: Something is taking sheep from the Greyteeth fold. Read the signs.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Forty short, and two of those were the bear's, I'd swear it on the oath I keep. The owner says Frosthollow thieves and wants the heather burned to bare rock. Count with my cottage-mate, find the bear's sign at Greytarn, and ask the collier what he saw, eh?
offer.handIn: The forty went up the Pass Road.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Up the Pass Road, driven, not dragged. Net and line, it's wolves, then, and a bear besides. Sit the fold with me after dark. If they come again, they'll find teeth waiting.
